filter-column-age-hint: Fihla amakhadi angene kulolu luhlu sekudlule insuku ezedlula leli nani. Ezinye izinhlu lamakhadi angaziwayo amalanga awo okungena kuhlala kubonakala. Ukuguqula ikhadi akuqalisi kutsha isikhathi salo kuluhlu.

advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Hluza amalanga amakhadi usebenzisa @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt kumbe @listEnteredAt. Isibonelo: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' kumbe @endAt = none. Faka ibizo lendawo ozenzele yona eliqala ngo-@ phakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna.
advanced-filter-description: Isihlungi esithuthukileyo sivumela ukubhala umbhalo olalezi zisebenzisi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Isikhala sisetshenziswa ukwehlukanisa izisebenzisi. Ungahlunga zonke izinkambu ezenziwe ngokwezifiso ngokubhala amabizo lamanani azo. Isibonelo: Field1 == Value1. Qaphela: Nxa izinkambu loba amanani elezikhala, kumele uwafake phakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna ezilodwa. Isibonelo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ukweqa izimpawu zokulawula ezilodwa (' /), ungasebenzisa \. Isibonelo: Field1 == I\'m. Ungahlanganisa futhi izimo ezinengi. Isibonelo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngokujwayelekileyo zonke izisebenzisi zihunyutshwa kusukela kwesobunxele kuye kwesokudla. Ungatshintsha ukuhlelwa ngokufaka izibaya. Isibonelo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ungasesha futhi izinkambu zombhalo nge-regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Kuyahambelana nxa ikhadi lisungulwa, kumbe isihloko loba incazelo yalo iguqulwa, njalo umbhalo omutsha ulalokhu (akulani mahluko phakathi kwezinhlamvu ezinkulu lezincane).
imported-member-no-account: Ilunga elingenisiweyo — akula akhawunti efanelanayo okwamanje
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Namathisela i-JSON ekhishwe ku-Kanboard: into elama-"columns" (loba imisebenzi ele-column_name) kanye lohlu lwe-"tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Amakholomu aba yizinhlu, imisebenzi ibe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Namathisela i-JSON yebhodi le-NextCloud Deck (ibhodi elama-"stacks", isitaki ngasinye silama-"cards"). Izitaki ziba yizinhlu, amakhadi abe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Namathisela i-JSON yeqoqo lemisebenzi ye-OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Izimo ziba yizinhlu, imisebenzi ibe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Namathisela uhlu lwe-JSON lwezinkinga ze-__sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Izinkinga ziba ngamakhadi ahlelwe kuzinhlu Ezivuliweyo / Ezivaliweyo.
import-board-instruction-asana: Namathisela i-JSON ekhishwe emisebenzini ye-Asana ({ "data": [...] } evela ekukhitshweni kwe-Asana loba GET /tasks). Imisebenzi ihlelwa ngezigaba (memberships); eqediweyo iya ku-Qediwe.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Namathisela i-JSON ekhishwe kuluhlu lwe-ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Izigaba ziba yizinhlu, izinto zibe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namathisela uhlu lwemisebenzi lwe-markdown (indlela ezisetshenziswa amathulusi e-markdown-kanban afana ne-Obsidian Kanban): izihloko ze "## Ibizo lohlu", nezinto ze "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ngaphansi. Izihloko ziba luhlu bese izinto ziba amakhadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Namathisela isakhiwo se-Leo (ifayela le-.leo). Izingxenye ezisezingeni eliphezulu ziba yizinhlu, izingxenye ezingaphansi kwazo ngokuqondileyo ziba ngamakhadi, umbhalo wengxenye ube yincazelo yekhadi. Izingxenye ezisemazingeni ajulileyo ziba yizinhlu zokuhlola. Izingxenye eziphawuliweyo zingeniswa njengeziqediweyo.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namathisela ifayela le-todo.txt: umsebenzi owodwa emzileni ngamunye, ngendlela uhlelo lwe-todo.txt lezinhlelo ezihambelanayo ezibhala ngayo. Imisebenzi ephelileyo ("x") iya kweseziphelile, +project lo-@context kuba ngamalebula, (A) iba yilebula yokuqakatheka, kuthi due: lo-t: kube zinsuku zokucina lezokuqala.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Namathisela umphumela we-task export: uluhlu lwe-JSON kumbe umsebenzi owodwa emgqeni ngamunye. Imisebenzi ephelileyo iya ku-Done, project le-priority kuba ngamalebula, annotations iba yimibono, kuthi depends ibe yikuncika emisebenzini evimbayo.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Khipha ifayela le-.boardarchive endaweni ecindezelweyo ubusukunamathisela okuse-board.jsonl yebhodi, lomugqa wenguqulo kumbe ngaphandle kwawo. Uphawu lokuqoqela emaqenjini ekubonweni kwebhodi luba yizinhlu, ezinye impawu zokukhetha ziba ngamalebula, izingxenye zombhalo lamabhokisi okumaka ziba yincazelo loluhlu lokuhlola, njalo imibono iyagcinwa. Imifanekiso lokunamathiselweyo akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ebhodini lakho le-Trello, yana ku-'Menu', bese ku-'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ukophele umbhalo ophumayo.
import-board-instruction-csv: Namathisela amanani ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma (CSV) / amanani ahlukaniswe ngamathebhu (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Namathisela i-JSON evela ekusesheni izinkinga kwe-Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/2/search), loba into efanayo { "issues": [...] }. Izimo ze-Jira ziba yizinhlu, izinkinga zibe ngamakhadi. Ungafaka ngokuzikhethela uhlu lwe-"automationRules" ukungenisa imithetho.
import-board-instruction-excel: Khetha ithebula le-.xlsx ngendlela ye-WeKan (amakholomu afanayo lokukhitshwa kwe-Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Umugqa wokuqala uyisihloko.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Ukusesha kungafaka izisebenzisi ukuze kucoliswe ukusesha. Izisebenzisi zichazwa ngokubhala ibizo lesisebenzisi lenani kuhlukaniswe yikholoni. Isibonelo, incazelo yesisebenzisi ethi `list:Blocked` inganciphisa ukusesha kube ngamakhadi asohlwini olubizwa *Blocked*. Nxa inani lilezikhala loba izimpawu ezikhethekileyo kumele lifakwe phakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna (isib. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - amakhadi asebhodini elabelwe inhlangano *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - amakhadi asebhodini elabelwe iqembu *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - amakhadi aphela phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-*<n>* kusukela khathesi. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ ibala wonke amakhadi osuku lokuphela oseludlulile.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - amakhadi adalwe ezinsukwini ezingu-*<n>* ezidluleyo loba ngaphansi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - amakhadi alungiswe ezinsukwini ezingu-*<n>* ezidluleyo loba ngaphansi
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - wonke amakhadi aseNgobweni yomlando langekho kuyo
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - lapho *<field>* kungokunye kwe-`__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` loba `__predicate_member__`. Ukufaka `-` phambi kwe-*<field>* kusesha ukungabi khona kwenani kuleyo nkambu (isib. `has:-due` kusesha amakhadi angelalanga lokuphela).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - lapho *<sort-name>* kungokunye kwe-`__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` loba `__predicate_modified__`. Ukuze uhlele ngokwehlayo, faka `-` phambi kwebizo lokuhlela.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - lapho *<n>* kuyinombolo epheleleyo engaphezu kukaziro echaza inani lamakhadi azaboniswa ekhasini ngalinye.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Izisebenzisi ezifanayo zihlanganiswa ngo-*OR*. Amakhadi amadanisa loba yisiphi isimo ayabuyiselwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` ingabuyisela amakhadi akuloba yiluphi uluhlu olubizwa *Blocked* loba *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Izisebenzisi ezitshiyeneyo zihlanganiswa ngo-*AND*. Kubuyiselwa kuphela amakhadi amadanisa zonke izisebenzisi ezitshiyeneyo. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` ibuyisela kuphela amakhadi asohlwini *Available* alelebula *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Izinsuku zingachazwa ngenombolo epheleleyo engaphezu loba ngaphansi kukaziro, loba kusetshenziswe `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` loba `__predicate_year__` ngesikhathi samanje.

database-migration-description: Thutha idatha esekelwe embhalweni (konke ngaphandle kokunamathiselweyo lezithombe zabasebenzisi, ezihlala kusistimu yamafayela) phakathi kwe-MongoDB le-FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Esinye isizindalwazi kumele sisebenze njalo sifinyeleleke (amaphothi azenzakalelayo: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; tshintsha nge-WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Nxa kuqediwe, khomba i-MONGO_URL kwesinye isizindalwazi ubusuqalisa kutsha i-WeKan (ku-Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb loba =mongodb).
database-migration-confirm: Kopishela wonke amaqoqo asekelwe embhalweni ku-__db__? Okunamathiselweyo lezithombe zabasebenzisi kusistimu yamafayela akuthinteki. Isizindalwazi okuhanjiswa kuso kumele sisebenze.
sandstorm-migration-description: Nxa i-WeKan isebenza phakathi kwe-grain ye-Sandstorm, isizindalwazi sayo esidala se-MongoDB 3 sithuthelwa ku-FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ekuqalisweni kokuqala, njalo okunamathiselweyo lezithombe zabasebenzisi kuhanjiswa kusuka kusizindalwazi kuya kuzikhombandlela ze-grain files/attachments le-files/avatars. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi lokho kuthutha kuphumelele yini lokuthi amafayela esizindalwazi se-MongoDB esidala angalungiswanga asasebenzisa indawo engakanani kudiski phakathi kwe-grain, njalo kukuvumela ukuthi ususe lawo mafayela ukuze ukhulule indawo.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Ngemva kokuthutha okuphumeleleyo idatha ihlala ku-FerretDB lakusistimu yamafayela, ngakho amafayela esizindalwazi se-MongoDB 3 esidala angalungiswanga angasuswa ukuze kukhululwe indawo kudiski ye-grain. Lokhu akubuyiseki.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Susa amafayela esizindalwazi se-MongoDB 3 angalungiswanga ukuze kukhululwe indawo kudiski? Idatha isithuthelwe ku-FerretDB lakusistimu yamafayela. Lokhu akubuyiseki.

feature-views-scrum-desc: Umsebenzi womkhiqizo osalindileyo, izikhathi zomsebenzi ezimfitshane, umbiko waleso sikhathi lesivinini somsebenzi.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Umsebenzi oseleyo, umsebenzi ophelileyo, ukugeleza okuqoqiweyo, isikhathi sokwenza lesokulinda, inani lomsebenzi ophelileyo, isikhathi umsebenzi osulindile, izivimbelo, i-Monte Carlo lezinye izilinganiso zokugeleza komsebenzi.

card-field-visibility-desc: The fields of Board Settings / Card that boards can show. An unticked field is hidden from every card, minicard and Board Settings / Card of every board. cards-loading-description: I-WeKan ilayisha amakhadi ebhodi ngokuzenzakalela: ibhodi elikhulu (elingaphezu komkhawulo wobukhulu) lilayisha kuphela amakhadi abonakala khathesi (ukuskrola okungapheliyo) lenani elibukhoma, ukuze lihlale lishesha njalo lisebenzise imemori lomkhawulokudlulisa omncane, kuthi amabhodi amancane alayishe wonke amakhadi ukuze asebenze ngendlela elula epheleleyo. Akulalutho olungahlelwa. Abasebenzisi bangaphoqelela imodi nge-CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) le-CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Ukulayishwa kwamakhadi ngobuvila kusahlolwa: amanani amakhadi lemikhawulo ye-WIP kuqondile, kodwa ukubukwa kweKhalenda/Ithebula/Gantt lokukhetha okunengi kubonisa kuphela amakhadi alayishiweyo kuze kube khathesi. Layisha kutsha amabhodi avuliweyo ngemva kokutshintsha lokhu.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, zonke izixhumanisi (kokubili izixhumanisi ze-markdown ezifana le-[label](url) lamathegi e-HTML <a href>) zihlala ziboniswa njengombhalo ongelalutho ongachofozekiyo kuyo yonke inkambu yombhalo ocebileyo (izihloko zamabhodi lamakhadi, izincazelo, amazwana, izinhlu zokuhlola, njll.). Lokhu kuvimbela izixhumanisi ezichofozekayo ezidukisayo. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe, ngakho izixhumanisi zihlala zichofozeka.
always-show-code-as-text: Hlala ubonisa yonke ikhodi njengombhalo ongelalutho
always-show-code-as-text-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, umbhalo ocebileyo awuboniswa njenge-markdown loba i-HTML: wonke umthombo uhlala uboniswa njengombhalo ongelalutho kuyo yonke inkambu yombhalo ocebileyo (izihloko zamabhodi lamakhadi, izincazelo, amazwana, izinhlu zokuhlola, njll.). Lokhu kuveza okumunyethwe okufihliweyo — amazwana e-HTML (<!-- -->), lapho izixhumanisi ze-markdown ezikhomba khona, i-JavaScript layo yonke enye ikhodi — ukuze yonke ikhodi ihlale ibonakala, ingachofozeki njalo ingasebenzi. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe, ngakho i-markdown iboniswa ngendlela ejwayelekileyo.
disable-all-import-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, zonke izici zokungenisa ziyavalwa: ukungenisa ibhodi kusuka ku-WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea le-Forgejo, kanye lokuphinda ibhodi. Izinketho zemenyu yokungenisa ziyafihlwa njalo iseva iyala zonke izicelo zokungenisa. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-all-export-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, zonke izici zokukhupha ziyavalwa: ukukhupha ibhodi njenge-WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, loba ku-NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, kanye lokukhupha okunamathiselweyo okukodwa. Izinketho zemenyu yokukhupha ziyafihlwa njalo iseva iyala zonke izicelo zokukhupha. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-import-avatars-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, izithombe zabasebenzisi azingeniswa. Amabizo lenye idatha kusaqhubeka kungeniswa; kweqiwa izithombe zabasebenzisi kuphela. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-export-avatars-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, izithombe zabasebenzisi azifakwa ekukhutshweni kwebhodi (ukukhupha kwe-WeKan JSON le-CSV). Amabizo abasebenzisi lenye idatha kusaqhubeka kukhutshwa; kweqiwa izithombe zabasebenzisi kuphela. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-import-users-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, ukungenisa ibhodi le-WeKan JSON kutshintsha ibizo lomsebenzisi, ibizo eligcweleyo lezinhlamvu zokuqala zomsebenzisi ngamunye abe yizibambi zenani (user1, user2, ...), kususe isithombe sakhe, njalo kubhale kutsha ukukhulunywa kwe-@username (lezinkambu zokucelwa ngu / kwabelwa ngu) phakathi kokumunyethwe yikhadi lamazwana angeniswayo. Akulabunikazi bangempela bomsebenzisi obuvela ebhodini lomthombo obugcinwayo. Ibala elithi "umsebenzisi" lilandela ulimi lomuntu ongenisayo. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-export-users-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, ukukhupha ibhodi kutshintsha ibizo lomsebenzisi, ibizo eligcweleyo lezinhlamvu zokuqala zomsebenzisi ngamunye abe yizibambi zenani (user1, user2, ...), kususe isithombe sakhe, njalo kubhale kutsha ukukhulunywa kwe-@username (lezinkambu zokucelwa ngu / kwabelwa ngu) phakathi kokumunyethwe ngamakhadi lamazwana. Ifayela elikhutshiweyo alilabunikazi bangempela bomsebenzisi. Ibala elithi "umsebenzisi" lilandela ulimi lomuntu okhiphayo. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Nxa kuvuliwe, ukukhupha ibhodi kutshintsha ibizo lomsebenzisi, ibizo eligcweleyo lezinhlamvu zokuqala zomsebenzisi ngamunye abe yizibambi zenani (user1, user2, ...), kususe isithombe sakhe, njalo kubhale kutsha ukukhulunywa kwe-@username (lezinkambu zokucelwa ngu / kwabelwa ngu) phakathi kokumunyethwe ngamakhadi lamazwana. Ifayela elikhutshiweyo alilabunikazi bangempela bomsebenzisi. Ibala elithi "umsebenzisi" lilandela ulimi lomuntu okhiphayo. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-activities-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, okufakwayo kokuphakelwa kwemisebenzi akurekhodwa njalo akuboniswa ndawo (kubha eseceleni yebhodi lethebhu yemisebenzi yekhadi). Akulamlando wokuthi ngubani owenze ini ogcinwayo. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-notifications-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, i-WeKan ayithumeli izaziso zokubukela (ngaphakathi kohlelo, nge-imeyili loba ezinye izisevisi) zanoma yiwuphi umsebenzi. Imisebenzi ingaqhubeka irekhodwa (ngaphandle nxa layo ivaliwe ngenhla); kuvinjelwa izaziso kuphela. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-watch-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, isici sokubukela siyavalwa — abasebenzisi abakwazi ukubhalisela amabhodi, izinhlu loba amakhadi ukuze bathole izaziso, njalo yonke imizamo yokutshintsha izinga lokubukela iyaliwa. Ngokuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
backup-description: Yenza isipele Sokunamathiselweyo, Izithombe zabasebenzisi kanye/loba Idatha (wonke amaqoqo asekelwe embhalweni angasikho okunamathiselweyo loba izithombe zabasebenzisi). I-.zip ithunyelwa ngqo endaweni yokugcina ekhethiweyo — akulafayela lesikhatshana — njenge-backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, imumethe YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars le-/data. Izindawo zokugcina zamafu (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) zisebenzisa imininingwane yokuqinisekisa ehlelwe kumathebhu azo okugcina.
backup-scope-description: Isenzakalo sonke, loba Inhlangano eyodwa. Isipele seNhlangano simumethe amabhodi ayo lakho konke okukuwo, kuhlanganise lokunamathiselweyo kwalawo mabhodi — kodwa kungabi lama-akhawunti abasebenzisi lezilungiselelo zesenzakalo, ngoba lokhu kwabelwana yizo zonke Izinhlangano. Ukubuyisela isipele seNhlangano kubhala kuphela kumabhodi aphethwe yileyo Nhlangano.
continuous-backup-description: Sithumela lonke untshintsho kusizindalwazi, kokunamathiselweyo, ezithombeni zabasebenzisi lakumarekhodi kufolda ngemizuzwana emilutshwana, ukuze kubuyiselwe kunoma yisiphi isikhathi. Sisebenza lesipele esihleliweyo, esakha izinqolobane ezipheleleyo.
continuous-backup-target: Ifolda okuzagcinwa kuyo (indlela epheleleyo, kwenye idiski, endaweni eyabelwana ngayo kunethiwekhi loba endaweni exhunywe nge-rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Amakhasi e-SQLite (amakhasi antshintshileyo ngesikhathi ngasinye esimisiweyo)
continuous-backup-base-every: Isisekelo esitsha njalo ngemva kwamahora amisiweyo
continuous-backup-key-file: Ifayela yesikhiye sokufihla ngekhodi (indlela epheleleyo ngaphandle kwefolda okuzagcinwa kuyo; inhlamvu ezingu-64 zohlelo lwenombolo olusekelwe ku-16 loba umutsho oyimfihlo olenhlamvu ezingu-16 kumbe ngaphezulu). Gcina ikhophi: ngaphandle kwale ifayela isipele asisoze sibuyiselwe.
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Ifayela yesizindalwazi se-SQLite (yakhiwa eceleni kwesipele, ayibhalwa phezu kwefayela esetshenziswayo loba sekutheni)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Sebenzisa isizindalwazi se-SQLite esakhiwe kutsha ekuqaliseni kutsha okulandelayo (isizindalwazi esidala esithathelwe indawo sizagcinwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela isizukulwane esikhethiweyo esikhathini esikhethiweyo? Isipele esiqhubekayo siyama okwesikhatshana ngesikhathi sokubuyisela.
backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela isipele esikhethiweyo? Okunamathiselweyo/izithombe zabasebenzisi kubhalwa kusistimu yamafayela njalo idatha kusizindalwazi ngokwemodi ekhethiweyo.
gcs-key-filename-description: Ngokuzikhethela: umzila wefayela lokhiye we-JSON ye-akhawunti yesevisi kuseva.
gcs-credentials-description: Ngokuzikhethela: namathisela ukhiye we-JSON ye-akhawunti yesevisi. Tshiya kungelalutho ukuze usebenzise ifayela lokhiye loba imininingwane ezenzakalelayo.
gcs-permissions-note: Nika i-akhawunti yesevisi ye-WeKan ukufinyelela kokufunda/ukubhala ebhakedeni: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → ibhakede lakho → Permissions → Grant access. Ku-"New principals", namathisela i-imeyili ye-akhawunti yesevisi — inani le-"client_email" elivela kukhiye wakho we-JSON — ubusukhetha indima ethi "Storage Object Admin" njalo Londoloza.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Tshiya kungelalutho ukuze ugcine inani lamanje.
gcs-bucket-description: Ibizo lebhakede le-Cloud Storage lokugcina amafayela.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: tshiya kungelalutho (kusebenzisa isiphetho sesifunda). Okusebenzisana le-S3: i-Endpoint URL evela ku-console yakho ye-MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ibhakede lakho → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ibizo lebhakede lakho (loba Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → umsebenzisi wakho → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → khetha ukusetshenziswa 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Kuboniswa njenge-'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Isikrini esifanayo lese-Access key ID; i-'Secret access key' iboniswa kanye kuphela nxa ukhiye udalwe — kopisha ngaleso sikhathi (loba Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → ibizo eliboniswa phezulu (njalo ngaphansi kwe-Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Data storage → Containers → isiqukathi sakho (loba + Container ukuze udale esinye).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → isikhethi sephrojekthi phezulu → i-ID yephrojekthi yakho (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → ibizo lebhakede lakho (loba Create ukuze udale elinye).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Umzila kuseva ye-WeKan oya kufayela lokhiye we-JSON ye-akhawunti yesevisi elilandiweyo (elidalwe ngezansi). Sebenzisa LOKHU LOBA unamathisele i-JSON enkambini engezansi.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → i-akhawunti yakho yesevisi → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (kulanda ifayela). Namathisela okumunyethweyo lapha, loba ulondoloze ifayela ubusumisa umzila walo ngenhla.
migration-stop-confirm: Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukumisa konke ukuthutha?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Ukuze okunamathiselweyo lezithombe zabasebenzisi kubonakale, kuhambise kusuka ku-CollectionFS kuya kuloba yiphi enye indawo yokugcina.
s3-bucket-description: S3 bucket name for storing files
s3-enabled-description: Sebenzisa i-AWS S3 loba i-MinIO ukugcina amafayela
s3-endpoint-description: S3 endpoint URL (e.g., s3.amazonaws.com or minio.example.com)
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Kwenza ukuhlola lokulungisa okupheleleyo kobuqotho bedatha yebhodi, kuhlanganise lokuhlelwa kwezinhlu, izindawo zamakhadi lesakhiwo semizila.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Kususa ngokuphepha izinhlu ezingelalutho eziphindwe kabili. Kususa kuphela izinhlu ezingelamakhadi FUTHI ezilolunye uluhlu olulesihloko esifanayo olumumethe amakhadi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Kuthola njalo kubuyisele amakhadi lezinhlu ezingela-swimlaneId loba listId. Kudala umzila othi 'Amakhadi alahlekileyo' ukuze zonke izinto ezilahlekileyo zibonakale futhi.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Kubuyisela yonke imizila, izinhlu lamakhadi aseNgobweni yomlando. Kulungisa ngokuzenzakalela loba yiphi i-swimlaneId loba listId engekho ukuze izinto zibonakale.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Kuthola njalo kulungise izinhlu ezingekho loba ezonakeleyo esakhiweni sebhodi.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Kubuyekeza ama-URL ezithombe zabasebenzisi zamalunga ebhodi ukuze asebenzise indawo yokugcina eqondileyo njalo kulungise izikhombo zezithombe eziphukileyo.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Kubuyekeza wonke ama-URL amafayela okunamathiselweyo kuleli bhodi ukuze asebenzise indawo yokugcina eqondileyo njalo kulungise izikhombo zamafayela eziphukileyo.
migrations-description: Sebenzisa ukuhlola lokulungisa ubuqotho bedatha yaleli bhodi. Ukuthutha ngakunye kungasetshenziswa ngokwehlukana.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzakwenza ukuthutha okupheleleyo ukuze kuhlole njalo kulungise ubuqotho bedatha yebhodi. Lokhu kungathatha isikhatshana. Qhubeka?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Lokhu kuzaqala kuguqule loba yiziphi izinhlu ezabelwanwayo zibe yizinhlu zomzila ngamunye, bese kususa izinhlu ezingelalutho eziloluhlu oluphindwe kabili olulesihloko esifanayo olumumethe amakhadi. Kuzasuswa kuphela izinhlu ezingelalutho ezingadingekiyo ngempela. Qhubeka?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzakudala umzila othi 'Amakhadi alahlekileyo' njalo kubuyisele wonke amakhadi lezinhlu ezingela-swimlaneId loba listId. Lokhu kuthinta kuphela izinto ezingekho eNgobweni yomlando. Qhubeka?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Lokhu kuzabuyisela YONKE imizila, izinhlu lamakhadi aseNgobweni yomlando, kubenze babonakale futhi. Zonke izinto ezilama-ID angekho zizalungiswa ngokuzenzakalela. Lokhu akubuyiseki lula. Qhubeka?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzathola njalo kulungise izinhlu ezingekho loba ezonakeleyo esakhiweni sebhodi. Qhubeka?

run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzabuyekeza wonke ama-URL amafayela okunamathiselweyo kuleli bhodi ukuze asebenzise indawo yokugcina eqondileyo. Qhubeka?

migration-progress-note: Sicela ulinde ngesikhathi sithuthela ibhodi lakho esakhiweni sakamuva...
conversion-info-text: Lokhu kuguqulwa kwenziwa kanye ebhodini ngalinye njalo kuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Ungaqhubeka usebenzisa ibhodi ngendlela ejwayelekileyo.
converting-board-description: Kuguqulwa isakhiwo sebhodi ukuze sisebenze ngcono. Lokhu kungathatha isikhatshana.
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Misa okwesikhatshana ukuthutha nxa ukusetshenziswa kwe-CPU kudlula leli phesenti (10-90)
migration-info-text: Ukuthutha izizindalwazi kwenziwa kanye njalo kuthuthukisa ukusebenza kohlelo. Umsebenzi uqhubeka ngemuva lanxa uvala isiphequluli sakho.
migration-warning-text: Sicela ungavali isiphequluli sakho ngesikhathi sokuthutha. Umsebenzi uzaqhubeka ngemuva kodwa ungathatha isikhathi eside ukuqeda.
account-locked: I-akhawunti ivalelwe okwesikhatshana ngenxa yemizamo yokungena eminengi eyehlulekileyo. Sicela uzame futhi ngemva kwesikhathi.
username-too-short: Ibizo lomsebenzisi kumele libe lezinhlamvu okungenani ezingu-3
problems-summary-help: Hlola izindawo zezinkinga osuzibukezile, ubusuchofoza u-Vuma ukuze umise kutsha inani lazo lezinkinga ezintsha.
problems-in-progress-help: Lokhu kuthutha loba ukulungisa kuyasebenza khathesi. Ukungena kungahamba kancane, loba kubonise ukuthi "Kumele ungene" loba isiphenduli esithi "Kuyalayishwa, sicela ulinde", kuze kuqedwe njalo i-CPU yehle.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Kulungiswe amakhadi angu-__fixed__. Amakhadi angu-__unfixable__ kawalabhodi njalo awakwazi ukulungiswa ngokuzenzakalela.

import-report-description: Ibhodi lenziwe, kodwa ezinye izingxenye zefayela azikwazanga ukulethwa. Umbiko ofanayo ugcinwe ku-Iphaneli yomlawuli → Izinkinga → Ukubuyisela.
import-parts-instruction: Izingxenye eziphawuliweyo kuphela ezingeniswayo. Ukukhetha okufanayo kuyasetshenziswa lapho kukhutshwa.

twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Skena ikhodi le ye-QR ngohlelo lokuqinisekisa (isibonelo Google Authenticator, Authy), ngemva kwalokho ufake ikhodi elamanani ayisithupha eyitshengisayo ukuze uqinisekise.
twoFactorCode-prompt: Faka ikhodi yakho yokuqinisekisa elamanani ayisithupha

sync-estimate-field-hint: Select a numeric field with a Jira field ID and estimate unit, as created by a mapped Jira import. Local changes are reviewed as conflicts. Missing source values are ignored; an explicit null clears the mapped value.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Isisindo kumbe isilinganiso sesikhathi se-GitLab sibhalwa endaweni yezinombolo oyikhethayo. Inguquko zalapha zihlolwa njengokungavumelani; udaba olungelasisindo lusula inani elixhunyiweyo.
email-recovery-description: Umugqa owodwa kumamukeli ngamunye. Dinga nge-ID yomsebenzisi. Okuqukethwe yimilayezo lezindawo ze-imeyili yomamukeli akuboniswa. Ukumisa okwesikhatshana kubamba imilayezo ekhona lezayo; ukuqhubeka kuzama ukuthumela imilayezo esemzileni khathesi. Ukukhansela kususa imilayezo efakwe emzileni kuze kube yisikhathi sesicelo. Nxa ukuthumela kuqhubeka, zama futhi ngemva kwesikhatshana. Umlayezo osuqalisile ukuthunyelwa awungeke ubuyiselwe emuva, njalo ukuthumela okungaqinisekanga kungaphindwa. Ukwehluleka okungapheliyo lemilayezo esifinyelele emkhawulweni wokuzama kugcinelwa ukuhlolwa. Ukuzama futhi imilayezo eyehlulekileyo kuqalisa umjikelezo omutsha wokuzama njalo kugcina ukumiswa okwesikhatshana okukhona.

email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwaniseki ukubala umzila wama-imeyili. Hlola imvumo yomlawuli lokutholakala kweseva.
email-recovery-busy: Ukuthumela kumbe omunye umsebenzi womzila kuyaqhubeka. Vuselela njalo uzame futhi ngemva kwesikhatshana.
email-recovery-failed: Umsebenzi awukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Vuselela umzila njalo uzame umsebenzi ofanayo futhi nxa kudingeka.
email-recovery-superseded: Isenzo esitsha somsebenzisi wohlelo sithathe indawo yalesi sicelo. Kuboniswa umumo womzila wakhathesi.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Khansela yonke imilayezo esemzileni khathesi yalumamukeli? Okuqukethwe yiyo kuzasuswa njalo ngeke kubuyiselwe. Imilayezo emitsha eyenziwe ngemva kwalesi sicelo izagcinwa.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Delivery could not be confirmed; review before retrying
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Delivery receipt could not be saved

A sprint or release that is missing is created on this board, with the dates the source gives; an existing one is matched by its source ID first, then by name. A local planning change stays until the source changes that issue's planning, and a first Sync never removes planning.

rule-email-recovery-description: Hlola imizamo ebhaliweyo yokuthumela ama-imeyili emithetho. Imizamo engaqinisekiswanga ingabe isathumela kumbe iphazamisekile. Lo umbiko kawuphindi uthumele njalo kawukhanseli ukuthumela.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Akulamizamo yokuthumela ama-imeyili emithetho ehambelana lalokhu kudinga.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Could not load rule email attempts. Refresh to try again.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: I-WeKan ayiphindi ithumele yona yodwa i-imeyili engaqinisekiswanga. Ukuthumela futhi kuya kuphela kubamukeli abangaqinisekiswanga. Yimake njengethunyelweyo nxa usazi ukuthi isifikile, kumbe ukhansele ukuthumela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Ukuthumela kokuqala kungabe kusaqhubeka. Unganquma ngemva kuka-__time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Thumela i-imeyili le futhi kubamukeli abangaqinisekiswanga? Loba ngubani iseva yakhe yemeyili eyamukele umlayezo ingazisanga i-WeKan uzawuthola kabili.

rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Khansela ukuthumela i-imeyili le? Ayisoze ithunyelwe kubamukeli abangaqinisekiswanga.

rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Ukuthumela futhi okwangaphambili kungabe kusaqhubeka. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhathi.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Bonke abamukeli sebeqinisekisiwe. Esikhundleni sokuyithumela futhi, yimake njengethunyelweyo.

rule-email-resolution-busy: Omunye umphathi uxazulula i-imeyili le. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhatshana.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: I-imeyili egciniweyo ayisahambelani lalumzamo, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxazululwa lapha.

rule-email-resolution-failed: I-imeyili le ayikwazanga ukuxazululwa. Vuselela ikhasi ubusuzama futhi.

stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.

stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: The user who started it no longer has write access to the whole list
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Saved by an earlier WeKan version without what started it
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.

stuck-sync-operation-missing: This operation is no longer pending.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: This operation has not been found stuck, so it cannot be discarded.

stuck-sync-operation-busy: This list is syncing right now. Try again in a moment.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.

interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.

interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.

interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
saml-login-not-started: Ukungena lokhu nge-SAML akuqaliswanga kule ithebhu yesiphequluli. Sicela ungene futhi.
history-request-pending-undo: Iseva ayikaqinisekisi ukuhlehlisa kwakho untshintsho lokucina.
history-request-pending-redo: Iseva ayikaqinisekisi ukuphinda wenze untshintsho lwakho lokucina.
history-request-hint: Ukuzama futhi kuphinda isicelo esifanayo, ngakho akusoze kuhlehlise untshintsho lwesibili.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: An undo, redo or restore of Scrum changes stopped on a conflict. Scrum edits on this board are blocked until it is resolved.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ of __total__ changes were written, __pending__ were not, and __conflicted__ were changed by someone else since.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Rolling back puts every changed record back as it was before; it is offered only when nobody else has changed those records since. Keeping the board as it is removes the stopped operation and changes no records. Either way, it is recorded in Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Keep the board as it is
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Keep every record as it is now, including the changes the stopped operation already wrote?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: A board administrator can roll it back or keep the board as it is.
login-setting-after-restart: Kuqala ukusebenza ngemva kokuthi i-WeKan iqaliswe kutsha
login-setting-env-only: Only the server environment sets these. They are shown here read-only.
